_doc: Template plan. Replace the source paths, then fill one piece per kept line in story order. lo/hi = hard bounds in the silence around the chosen attempt, ws/we = Whisper start of its first word / end of its last word, text = the expected words. Settings left out use the defaults in scripts/common.py (tail_mode tight, reframe on, speech leveling on). Times below are illustrative.
